items.briefing:
Online scams continue to be a growing concern, with reports highlighting an ongoing surge in fraudulent websites and deceptive online content targeting everyday users. Australians should remain cautious about unsolicited emails, fake websites, and too-good-to-be-true offers circulating online. Separately, OpenAI has launched a new ChatGPT feature for macOS that stores your computer activity history — Australian Mac users should review their ChatGPT privacy settings to understand what data is being collected and stored.

**Practical tip:** If you use ChatGPT on a Mac, check your account privacy settings today and disable any history features you're not comfortable with.

featured.title: Australia & New Zealand face surge in critical flaws
featured.quote: Critical vulnerability backlog leaves Australian organisations dangerously exposed to immediate attack.
